description: Make the link that opens the project in the Mokxi editor and runs it: the board, its code, and the parts and wires when there are any. The link carries the whole project and opens with no account. For a signed-in Mokxi account it also saves a copy as a private project (a retry within a minute returns the same one) and returns that project's address, which is then the main link; with the account's projects full nothing is saved and the result says so. Refused, with the errors, while the project has any. Returns the link, a summary, the parts and wires, and Mokxi's own picture of the circuit. In the editor, Upload to board writes the project's sketch to a real Arduino AVR or ESP32-C3 board over USB (Chrome or Edge).

project.description: A project in the Mokxi AI format: {"format": "mokxi-ai/1", "name": "...", "board": "uno", "parts": [{"id": "led1", "type": "led"}], "wires": [["board.13", "led1.A"]], "code": {"sketch.ino": "..."}}. get_project_format has the full rules.

board.description: A board type from list_boards, such as "uno", "esp32" or "pico"; null for a circuit with no board.

code.description: File name to its text: {"sketch.ino": "..."} or {"main.py": "..."}.

wires.description: Pairs of ends, "partId.pin"; the board is "board". A third item may name a color.

name: create_project
title: Make a link
